documents.text: ## Old config format no longer supported ESLint v9 introduced a [new default configuration format](./configure/configuration-files) based on the `eslint.config.js` file. The old format, which used `.eslintrc` or `.eslintrc.json`, could still be enabled in v9 by setting the `ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG` environment variable to `false`. Starting with ESLint v10.0.0, the old configuration format is no longer supported. **Codemod:** Use the [@eslint/v9-to-v10](#use-migration-codemods) codemod to automate much of this migration. Use the [@eslint/v9-to-v10-linter-api](#use-migration-codemods) codemod to update deprecated `FlatESLint` and `LegacyESLint` usage. **To address:** - Or follow the instructions in the [configuration migration guide](./configure/migration-guide). - Be aware that the deprecated APIs `FlatESLint` and `LegacyESLint` have been removed. Always use `ESLint` instead. - The `configType` option of the `Linter` class can no longer be set to `"eslintrc"`. Remove the option to use the new configuration format. **Related issue(s):** [#13481](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/13481)

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
